title: High-end Quality Tencel-linen Casual Mens Suit

Product information:
Product Overview
This men's Tencel linen suit features high-quality Lyocell and linen blend fabric, offering a lightweight, breathable, and soft touch ideal for all-season wear. The set includes an open-front shirt and full-length trousers, designed with a simple and elegant aesthetic suitable for casual occasions.

Specifications
Material: Lyocell, Linen Blend
Style: Refined Casual
Type: Open-front Shirt + Full-length Trousers
Sleeve Length: Long Sleeve
Thickness: Thin
Season: All Seasons
Color Options: Plum Purple/Natural Linen, Sky Blue/Natural Linen, White/White, Natural Linen/Natural Linen, Army Green/Army Green, Black/Black, Gray/Gray, Royal Blue/Royal Blue, Dry Green/Dry Green, Coffee/Coffee
Size: M, L, XL, 2XL, 3XL

Note: 1. Asian sizes are 1 to 2 sizes smaller than European and American people. Choose the larger size if your size between two sizes. Please allow 2-3cm differences due to manual measurement. 2. Please check the size chart carefully before you buy the item, if you don't know how to choose size, please contact our customer service. 3.As you know, the different computers display colors differently, the color of the actual item may vary slightly from the following images.
